t: A free plan from NASA JPL for building your own six-wheel Mars-style rover.
steps: Read the official docs and the parts list in the nasa-jpl open-source-rover repo on GitHub.
Budget about 1,600 US dollars in parts and at least 100 person-hours of build time.
Order the aluminum frame parts from goBILDA and ask about the 15 percent education discount.
Upload the DigiKey parts file to a cart and order the control board parts.
Have the control board made from the Gerber files and solder it together.
Buy a Raspberry Pi 5, a 4S LiPo battery, a balance charger, and a fireproof battery bag.
Follow the mechanical and wiring guides to build the frame and connect the motors.
Install ROS 2 and the osr-rover-code software on the Pi, then drive it with a game controller.
